root: ^The last sample proved successful. Closer age proximity to my Orianna as well as the blood cells and spinal fluid seem to be a better match. Maybe younger candidates are the solution?
^I still need more samples for my research.

^I can't go back to the same donor, even though it might be easier. It could be lethal, seeing that the previous individuals have not woken up. Maybe there is something wrong with their diet and the sample volume I'm collecting?
^I can't quit, Orianna's state isn't getting better fast enough. If I find a cure, then I could help the others too.</font>
